definition: With little or no delay; immediately
etymology: From Latin 'promptus' (brought forth, at hand), past participle of 'promere' (to bring forth)
contextSentence: I looked up the phone number in the phone book and promptly handed the phone to my older brother.
contextSentenceKo: 전화번호부에서 전화번호를 찾아보고 바로 전화기를 형에게 건넸어요.

definition: To join in or take part in an activity
etymology: From Middle English 'part taken' (to take part), back-formation from 'partaker'
contextSentence: Too homesick to partake in early freshman partying.
contextSentenceKo: 너무 향수병이 심해서 신입생 파티에 참여하지도 못했죠.

definition: To give up completely; to cease to support or look after
etymology: From Old French 'abandoner' (to surrender, release), from 'a bandon' (at one's disposal)
rootBreakdown: a- (에) + bandon (권한, 지배) → 통제에서 벗어나다 → 포기하다
contextSentence: I wanted to trade in my books, abandon my major, and head back home.
contextSentenceKo: 책을 반납하고 전공을 포기하고 고향으로 돌아가고 싶었어요.

definition: To follow or chase; to seek to attain or accomplish
etymology: From Anglo-French 'pursuer', from Latin 'prosequi' (to follow up)
contextSentence: The confident behaviors I needed to pursue this dream were not yet available.
contextSentenceKo: 이 꿈을 추구하는 데 필요한 자신감 있는 행동들은 아직 갖추어지지 않았어요.

definition: To place or arrange things in a straight line; to be in agreement
rootBreakdown: a- (으로) + ligne/line (선) → 한 줄로 맞추다 → 일치시키다
contextSentence: My behaviors did not align with these confident attitudes.
contextSentenceKo: 제 행동은 이런 자신감 있는 태도와 일치하지 않았어요.

definition: To drive or push something forward; to cause to move in a particular direction
contextSentence: They had to work on the behaviors associated with this attitude in order to propel their career forward.
contextSentenceKo: 그들은 커리어를 발전시키기 위해 이 태도와 관련된 행동들을 노력해야 했어요.

definition: In a way that produces powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind
contextSentence: I vividly remember standing on the warning track of the baseball field.
contextSentenceKo: 야구장 워닝트랙에 서 있던 것이 생생하게 기억나요.

definition: The force gained by a moving body; the impetus of continued progress
etymology: From Latin 'momentum' (movement, moving power), from 'movere' (to move)
contextSentence: Counting will get you started and momentum will keep you going.
contextSentenceKo: 카운팅이 시작하게 해주고, 탄력이 계속 나아가게 해줘요.

definition: To a very great degree or extent; tremendously
etymology: From Latin 'enormis' (irregular, immense), from 'e-' (out of) + 'norma' (rule, pattern)
rootBreakdown: e- (밖으로) + norma (규범) + -ous + -ly → 규범을 벗어날 정도로 → 엄청나게
contextSentence: This behavior helped me enormously when I published my podcast.
contextSentenceKo: 이 행동은 제가 팟캐스트를 발행했을 때 엄청난 도움이 됐어요.

definition: To evaluate or analyze critically; to review or assess
etymology: From French 'critique', from Greek 'kritikos' (able to judge)
contextSentence: Bold title and all for all the world to see, hear, critique, and have their opinions.
contextSentenceKo: 대담한 제목으로 온 세상이 보고, 듣고, 비평하고, 의견을 가질 수 있게요.

definition: In a way that uses metaphor; not literally but as a figure of speech
contextSentence: Take a seat at the table. Not metaphorically speaking, actually take a seat at the table.
contextSentenceKo: 테이블에 자리를 잡으세요. 비유적으로가 아니라, 실제로 테이블에 앉으세요.

definition: Awards or expressions of praise; honors given in recognition of achievement
etymology: From French 'accolade' (embrace), from Italian 'accollata' (embrace around the neck)
rootBreakdown: ad- (으로) + collum (목) + -ade → 목에 걸어주는 것 → 영예/찬사
contextSentence: Rather than feeling sorry for yourself that it was not you accepting the accolades.
contextSentenceKo: 그게 내가 아니라고 자기연민에 빠지는 대신 어떨까요?

definition: To support or strengthen; to prop up
etymology: From Old English 'bolster' (cushion, pillow), related to 'beal' (to swell)
contextSentence: Bolster your confidence for a new activity through your already great performance in another.
contextSentenceKo: 이미 잘하고 있는 분야의 성과를 통해 새로운 활동에 대한 자신감을 강화하세요.

definition: Something that has been achieved successfully; an achievement
etymology: From Old French 'acomplir' (to complete), from Latin 'ad-' (to) + 'complere' (to fill up)
rootBreakdown: ad- (으로) + com- (완전히) + plere (채우다) + -ment → 완전히 채우다 → 성취
contextSentence: What is your most proud accomplishment?

definition: Made smaller or less; reduced in size, importance, or value
etymology: From Latin 'diminuere' (to break into small pieces), from 'de-' (away) + 'minuere' (to lessen)
rootBreakdown: de- (아래로) + minu- (작게 하다) + -ish → 작아지게 하다 → 줄어들다
contextSentence: The recollection of that success is diminished.

definition: The action of remembering something; a memory
etymology: From Latin 'recolligere' (to collect again), from 're-' (again) + 'colligere' (to gather)
rootBreakdown: re- (다시) + col- (함께) + legere (모으다) + -tion → 다시 모으다 → 회상
contextSentence: The recollection of that success is diminished.

definition: To strengthen or support, especially by adding more material or effort
rootBreakdown: re- (다시) + in- (안으로) + force (힘) → 다시 힘을 불어넣다 → 강화하다
contextSentence: This will create a marker in your brain to rewire and reinforce the behaviors.
contextSentenceKo: 이것은 뇌에 표시를 남겨 행동을 다시 강화하고 재프로그래밍하게 해줘요.

definition: To change the way something functions or is connected, especially neural pathways
contextSentence: This will create a marker in your brain to rewire and reinforce the behaviors that led to the success.
contextSentenceKo: 이것은 뇌에 표시를 남겨 성공을 이끌었던 행동을 다시 강화하고 재프로그래밍하게 해줘요.
